scope: In-memory diagnostic builds, no repository source edits or production artifacts; all 848 official icons and registration metadata retained. Externalized thumbnails referenced by hypothetical hash URLs; assets not uploaded. Not an App performance A/B.
notes: Two diagnostic esbuild builds use the same production define/minification and keep all 848 icons; this is not an installed App benchmark.

Hypothetical short asset URLs used in the diagnostic are not uploaded or wired into production. Real publication must resolve absolute asset origins, cached raw SVG retrieval and theme-aware previews.
The model JSON size and registration JavaScript size are different artifacts. Do not add their gzip/raw values together.
